system_thesis_interpretation: v1e is a bounded end-to-end engineering canary, not a test of the frozen Paper-1 headline. Operationally it asks whether a frozen 32B controller can turn an environment-generated public episode stream into immutable typed witnessed rows, add fallible same-model-supported relations through a local recurrent proposal/check loop, request one target-absent return frontier, use prospectively frozen text-reader interventions to solve one aligned seed-5 twin pair, and, only after a reviewed text pass, expose selected M1_OWN semantics through exactly two isolated rank-64 7B adapters. Declarative M rows, adapter parameters, and per-trace scratch are three distinct state substrates. The proposal correctly prevents private truth and outcome scores from feeding construction, keeps false model-supported rows eligible, fixes no-retry ceilings, and localizes module and whole-organism credit. Its public projection vectors, legal P001084/M001084 reducer vector, identity domain through E/M000048, and arithmetic ceilings are internally reproducible. However, the exact package does not yet attain its claimed single executable semantic lock: the file dependency matrix has non-enumerated prose wildcard endpoints, and terminal-review rejection or invalidity has no closed non-recursive transition artifact to the promised HUMAN_TERMINAL. Rework is therefore required before ratification or implementation. The explicit SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED review-evidence departure is acceptable in principle for this narrow canary only as a human-accepted governance limitation, because the package denies authentication and independence claims; it cannot support statements that self-certification is technically prevented.
graph_delta_interpretation: The persistent declarative graph starts with the sole CPU projector: each allowed public episode becomes host-audit E_i and exactly one life-local witnessed M_i, while only M aliases can enter cognition. DREAM reads one trigger plus at most five deterministic eligible neighbors and emits PASS or an audit-only P proposal. A prospectively paired SELF_CHECK reads the proposal projection, its cited rows, and at most eight supplied rows; only a structurally legal SUPPORTED verdict creates the immutable M001xxx owner, with ordered citations, derived depth, and external E-lineage union. CONTRADICTED, UNRESOLVED, malformed, illegal, duplicate, prose, prediction, confidence, counters, and receipts never become graph nodes. The graph can grow breadth-like through WAKE/REACTIVATE/SLEEP and goal-routed return selection, but correctness is not asserted at write time. THINK0 does not write evidence: only its exact REQUEST_RETURN focus, or NO_FOCUS on DEFER/failure, controls later OWN selection. THINK1 read handles and scratch form temporary per-trace working graphs and never feed a later DREAM in this change. M1_OWN alone compiles into per-life LoRA examples, so adapter weights are a separate parametric projection of the frozen semantic manifest, not a replacement for row provenance. Text and LoRA readers expose the same local H-handle/kind/fields/status/semantic-hash projection; row IDs, citations, depth, backend, donor, scores, and host provenance stay outside the thinker. The causal graph is evaluated only after all runnable traces seal: M0 and DIST losses, OWN-only correct focus content, donor-valid TWIN, PATH loss, SHAM retention, and later ancestral H use plus COMMIT jointly assign credit to the registered return/content path rather than to generation alone. Authority is a separate monotone control graph from human ratification to CPU, reviewed DEV, reviewed T, conditional reviewed L, and terminal stop; no scientific state may create authority.
loop_delta_interpretation: Per heldout life, the constructor has one common 84-slot prefix: 46 WAKE slots, 22 REACTIVATE slots after wake indices 3,7,...,43, and 16 SLEEP slots. M0 freezes that prefix. Fresh THINK0 has at most twelve operations over the non-answer public probe and atomic M0 reads. OWN and DIST fork the same prefix counters and independently execute slots 84..99; OWN uses the THINK0 focus or NO_FOCUS, while DIST uses the pre-dispatch public control, and M0 has literally zero return calls. Each of the 116 DREAM opportunities per life has one pre-registered SELF_CHECK partner; only a schema-valid new-owner CREATE dispatches it, while PASS, invalid CREATE, duplicate, or upstream invalidity resolves the fixed partner with exactly one zero-attempt ledger row. This yields 232 DREAM plus 232 SELF_CHECK plus 24 THINK0 plus 144 THINK1_TEXT opportunities, or 632 heldout controller opportunities. DEV has 216 fixed THINK1 opportunities. Conditional L has 48 THINK1 opportunities, for a maximum 896 32B controller calls; the two fits, 96 fidelity cases, and at most 48 atomic 7B recognition reads are separately counted. Every trace stops on COMMIT, REQUEST_RETURN where legal, DEFER, model failure, infrastructure invalidity, or the twelfth operation; a nonterminal operation twelve is retained only in the trace and becomes BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, and no thirteenth call or retry exists. After M1 and candidates seal, the goal question is revealed, PATH/SHAM and six T readers seal, every runnable T trace executes before scoring, and only a reviewed full T pass unlocks two pristine per-life fits. Both fits and both complete 48-case fidelity sets seal before the joint gate absent infrastructure invalidity; only then may L-OWN/L-TWIN run. No THINK1 outcome, private score, or LoRA result feeds another construction loop, selects a corpus, repairs a row, or changes a registered denominator.
claim_delta_interpretation: A green text stage can support only realized dependence of this exact ontology- and proof-sequence-scaffolded seed-5 twin-pair pipeline on the registered post-prefix return treatment and life-local reader content. It cannot establish necessity of the shared recurrent prefix, generic construction, model-selected action, action improvement, learning across actions, generalization, reliability, scale, or the Paper-1 thesis. A green LoRA stage can support only two per-life adapters reaching their separate 44/48 thresholds on selected candidate-constrained training-set-resubstitution cues and supporting the registered own/donor decision paths. The host pre-resolves cardinality and supplies answer-bearing shared rosters, so open recall, unseen preservation, whole-corpus storage, text equivalence, durability, capacity, RAG superiority, or generalization language is forbidden. A negative result is likewise stage-and-reason local. The four-state terminal claim model and exact render order correctly prevent later-stage positives from appearing in earlier terminals and treat SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE as control infeasibility with five-arm description but no weakened causal claim. The review departure may be reported only as role-labelled and freshness-labelled SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED procedure. Because the bytes cannot authenticate actors or contexts, the graph rationale that it prevents self-certification and the P1CB10 falsifier statement that the experiment cannot self-certify are stronger than the evidence and must be narrowed to procedural prohibition, disclosure, and human/operator enforcement.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The intended visibility boundary is coherent across the cognitive path. DREAM sees selected closed witnessed/model-supported rows and, only in return branches, the registered focus; SELF_CHECK sees only the proposal projection, exact premises, and deterministic additional rows. THINK0 sees the public non-answer probe and provenance-free M0 H reads but not the final animal/question, answer, donor, audit state, or private truth. The final question is host-sealed before heldout dispatch but exposed only after M0/M1, corpora, fidelity rows, and candidates seal; path and sham use host coordinates after that reveal and before any T output. THINK1 sees the public question, fixed state-token vocabulary, bounded scratch, and one provenance-free read result; backend/donor identity and host roster/scores remain hidden. COMPILE_OR_TRAIN consumes only fixed eligible M1_OWN semantic rows, never focus, goal, audit prose, result, or cross-life corpus. Offline evaluation is the first consumer of private truth and cannot feed back. One matrix cell is not atomically stated: FINAL_GOAL_OR_DONOR_BACKEND is marked visible at THINK1 even though its own reason and the state/read schemas expose the final question while hiding donor/backend identity. The lower-level contracts resolve execution toward hidden donor identity, but the exhaustive matrix should split these information items or give separate visibility values so a matrix-only consumer cannot infer donor visibility.
acceptance_test_interpretation: P1CB01 advertises exact file/edge closure, schema resources, and monotone authority, but cannot presently measure a unique file graph because 25 otherwise reciprocal declarations are represented only through the undefined aggregate phrases 'all operation and state schemas', 'all normative contracts and schemas', 'all schema files', and 'all other normative files'; explicit edge enumeration or a closed expansion table is required. P1CB02 appropriately tests private/audit/goal/cross-cue-roster taint, rejects invalid roster substitution before state replacement, and allows only registered post-reveal/focus descendants to vary. P1CB03 covers the corrected premise-then-supplied-support reducer, kind discrimination, immutable rows, lineage/depth/hash, duplicate ownership, and no-verifier boundary; the registered semantic and record hashes recompute. P1CB04 tests the 23 kind-disjoint one-null query shapes, exact cue-instance roster binding, common provenance-free read projection, and atomic mounts; passing supports backend isolation, not semantic equivalence. P1CB05 tests legally projected six-life DEV headroom and shortcut resistance; the eight public projection golden vectors recompute exactly, including seed-1 index 48 and unchanged seed-5 bytes. P1CB06 measures deterministic schedule/accounting and only the sixteen-slot post-prefix return intervention, not recurrence as a whole. P1CB07 is a strong prospective content-dependence conjunction and correctly treats missing roots as mechanism failure and sham infeasibility as five-arm control-identifiability failure without causal credit. P1CB08 adequately locks two fits and fidelity/own-donor behavior, but its maximum evidence remains selected-cue candidate-constrained training-set resubstitution. P1CB09 correctly fixes all 896 potential controller opportunities, including the 232 paired companions, one-effect accounting, exact priority, stage-failure versus trace-terminal separation, ceilings, and no retry. P1CB10 correctly tests packet immutability, reviewer supremacy, changed-byte rereview, claim states, and evidence disclaimers, but it cannot test actual identity/freshness/independence and its every-path human-stop assertion is incomplete when an EARLY_TERMINAL or STAGE_L_TERMINAL reviewer rejects, is invalid, or the terminal packet itself cannot be built; that path needs a closed direct fail-stop artifact or a finite non-recursive transition rule.
assumptions: RFC8785 JCS, cross-resource JSON-Schema resolution, hash relations, contextual identity bounds, and semantic contracts will be implemented as independently checked CPU code in the post-ratification executable lock; ordinary JSON-Schema shape validation alone is insufficient.

The pinned 32B and 7B snapshots, a single-device bfloat16 runtime with enough memory, deterministic kernels, and the listed software stack can be materialized later; absence or drift routes to the registered precondition or infrastructure terminal and is not silently repaired.

The offline evaluator reads private truth only after every prospectively runnable trace for the relevant stage is sealed and has no write edge back into requests, memory, corpora, adapters, or authority.

The SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED departure is evaluated as a governance-evidence limitation only; actual fresh-context and role separation remain external operator obligations under AGENTS.md and are not inferred from repository strings.

ambiguities.question: What exact normative algorithm expands the four aggregate consumes_from phrases into the 25 filename-level reciprocal edges that are not literally declared at both endpoints?
ambiguities.impact: P1CB01 cannot independently establish the claimed exhaustive dependency graph without implementation-selected category membership or a tautological expansion from the opposite endpoint; this is a release blocker.

ambiguities.question: When a terminal reviewer returns REJECT/INVALID, role overlap is detected during terminal review, or the terminal packet/disposition cannot be produced, does the system enter HUMAN_TERMINAL directly, mint an authority token despite the two-APPROVE rule, or recursively create another EARLY_TERMINAL review?
ambiguities.impact: The exact state machine does not specify one finite artifact-bearing route for every promised terminal path; recursive review or an unaudited terminal transition remains possible.

ambiguities.question: Why is FINAL_GOAL_OR_DONOR_BACKEND one information item marked visible at THINK1 when the final question is visible but donor/backend identity is explicitly hidden?
ambiguities.impact: The detailed state and reader schemas imply the safe interpretation, but the allegedly exhaustive visibility matrix is not atomic and can be misread as authorizing donor/backend disclosure.

ambiguities.question: Will the human decision owner accept that role and freshness separation are operator-enforced but unauthenticated, with no durable proof that distinct fresh actors actually performed the reviews?
ambiguities.impact: This does not invalidate the narrow scientific canary if explicitly accepted and disclosed, but it materially weakens governance auditability and cannot be described as preventing self-certification.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The exact v1e semantic-consistency matrix is not yet the claimed machine-exhaustive reciprocal filename graph.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Literal endpoint comparison leaves 25 provides_to declarations without a filename-identical consumes_from declaration. They are apparently intended to be covered by four free-text group labels, but no closed membership table or expansion algorithm is normative, and 'all operation and state schemas' is being asked to cover proposal, memory-row, read-result, and scratch dependencies as well. A P1CB01 implementer would have to choose the expansion, contrary to the no-semantic-choice rule inherited from v1d R01.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Rework before ratification: enumerate every filename edge at both endpoints, or add a closed named-group registry with exact ordered member arrays and an exact expansion algorithm; bind its omission, extra-member, category-mismatch, and asymmetric-edge negatives in P1CB01.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The claim that every failure and review outcome reaches HUMAN_TERMINAL is stronger than the specified terminal-review transition semantics.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Successor and HUMAN_TERMINAL authority tokens are described as requiring two APPROVE dispositions, while reviewer REJECT/INVALID terminates the exact bytes. The package does not define whether a rejection of an EARLY_TERMINAL or STAGE_L_TERMINAL packet produces a direct terminal receipt, may mint a token with non-APPROVE dispositions, or triggers another review. Missing/invalid terminal artifacts present the same bootstrapping problem. Therefore the promised total state machine is not closed.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Rework before ratification: define one non-recursive fail-stop transition for terminal-review rejection, invalidity, overlap, and terminal-artifact construction failure; give it a closed schema, exact predecessor/evidence rules, and P1CB01/P1CB10 vectors, and state explicitly whether it emits an authority token or a distinct direct HUMAN_TERMINAL receipt.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The unverified-review departure can expose and procedurally forbid self-certification, but it cannot technically prevent or detect it.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Any producer could self-declare distinct actor strings and zero prior turns because there is intentionally no authenticated issuer, canonical identity lookup, or freshness proof. Most v1e wording correctly admits this, but the monotone-authority rationale says it prevents self-certification and the P1CB10 falsifier says the experiment cannot self-certify. Those claims conflict with the selected SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED boundary.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Retain the departure for the narrow canary if the human accepts it, but replace prevention/proof language with exact statements that separation is requested, role-labelled, hash-bound, externally operator-enforced, unverified, and never scientific evidence.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: FINAL_GOAL_OR_DONOR_BACKEND should not have one visible THINK1 cell because its two components have different permissions.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The final public question is visible, whereas donor/backend identity is forbidden by the reader, taint, and matched-mount contracts. Combining them under visible weakens the matrix's advertised exactness even though lower-level schemas select the safe behavior.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Split FINAL_GOAL and DONOR_BACKEND_IDENTITY into separate information items and regenerate the exact cartesian matrix, or encode separate component permissions in a closed non-disjunctive cell schema and test them in P1CB02/P1CB04.
